subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should this issue remain the broad Control UI zh-CN tab-localization tracker, and which open tab-localization PRs should be rebased, consolidated, or replaced first?
rationale: Current main still has source-proven English tab copy, but the remaining work spans overlapping PRs and translation-scope choices that automation should not resolve without maintainer sequencing.

options.title: Keep Broad Tab Tracker
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate Agents, Skills, Channels, Sessions, Nodes, and Debug localization while requiring focused PRs to follow the generated i18n pipeline.

options.title: Split By Surface
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only after creating or selecting separate canonical trackers for each tab and preserving the existing related PR evidence.

options.title: Fold Into Localization Epic
options.body: Supersede this issue into the broader localization epic only if maintainers choose that epic as the canonical owner for Control UI tab interiors.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tab Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate Agents, Skills, Channels, Sessions, Nodes, and Debug localization while requiring focused PRs to follow the generated i18n pipeline.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent merged PRs make steipete the clearest routing candidate for deciding how to sequence the Control UI tab and generated-locale work.
